scope: Policy-to-reference mapping for content review. Product category and legal applicability require confirmation; policy Pass is not legal certification.

references.title: PerBPOM 3/2022 — Persyaratan Teknis Klaim Kosmetika
references.scope: Cosmetic claims; verify category, claim wording, substantiation, and current instrument before a legal conclusion.

references.title: PerBPOM 18/2024 — Penandaan, Promosi, dan Iklan Kosmetik
references.scope: Cosmetics advertising, evidence for benefit claims and restrictions on testimonials/certification representations. Not a rule for every product category.

provisions.summary: Promosi kosmetik harus objektif, jujur dan tidak menyesatkan; tidak memberi kesan sebagai obat atau pencegah penyakit.
Promosi memerlukan notifikasi kosmetik dan kesesuaian informasi notifikasi.

provisions.location: Pasal 17; Lampiran VI II.3.d dan II.4.d
provisions.summary: Klaim manfaat dan pernyataan sertifikasi tertentu memerlukan bukti yang dapat dipertanggungjawabkan.
Label halal pada penandaan kosmetik dicantumkan setelah sertifikat halal diperoleh. Ketentuan ini mengenai penandaan, bukan bukti otomatis bahwa setiap iklan patuh.

references.title: SE Menkominfo 9/2023 — Etika Kecerdasan Artifisial
references.scope: Ethical guidance: transparency, accountability, security and personal data protection. Do not describe a circular as an AI certification scheme.

references.title: UU 27/2022 — Pelindungan Data Pribadi
references.scope: Processing of personal data, data subject rights and controller obligations; export/delete endpoints alone do not establish compliance.

references.title: BPJPH — kanal resmi informasi jaminan produk halal
references.scope: Verify the actual product, holder, certificate and applicable rules. No certificate lookup or mandatory-halal deadline engine is implemented. An uploaded source is not independent certificate validation.

references.title: UU 8/1999 - Perlindungan Konsumen
references.scope: Rujukan umum informasi promosi kepada konsumen; konfirmasi konteks usaha dan ketentuan sektoral.

provisions.summary: Melarang promosi tidak benar mengenai karakteristik, standar, potongan harga dan keadaan barang/jasa.
Melarang pernyataan tidak benar atau menyesatkan mengenai harga, kegunaan, kondisi, jaminan, diskon, hadiah dan bahaya penggunaan.

limitations: Legal references are not automatically applied as article-level legal verdicts.
No automated BPOM notification or BPJPH certificate verification.
Model citation validation checks identity/location; it does not prove semantic entailment of every claim.
No OCR or vision review of the base image. A person inspects it and the rendered text before visual approval.
AI-provider data processing agreements, retention policy and legal basis require operator review.
Changes in AI and halal regulation must be checked before deployment; no current regulatory completeness claim is made.
Checked provisions are paraphrased editorial references, not a full amendment-status review or an automated finding of statutory breach. Historical reviews are not retrospectively reclassified.
